Flight: Numerous fictional superheroes possess this ability.

Darth Vader: The character first appeared on cinema screens in 1977.

James Earl Jones provided his distinctive voice.
His original identity is Anakin Skywalker.
Batman: The character made his comic book debut in 1939.
Bob Kane and Bill Finger created the character.
